sources.title: AI2 OLMo — Open Language Models for Research and Development
sources.snippet: AI2 OLMo (Open Language Model) is a series of open-source large language models developed by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2). Designed for academic research and transparent development, OLMo provides full access to training data, code, and model weights. This allows developers and researchers to fine-tune custom models, experiment with foundational architectures, and build applications ...
